title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E15 — Ruby Dee/Ossie Davis
Ruby Dee and Ossie Davis, aided by the music of composer-saxophonist Lucky Thompson, give dramatic readings of the poetry of a writer named Robert Cornell Kaufman.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E10 — A Question of Honor
All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E12 — Educating Katherine
Katherine gets a taste of the worst: being a volunteer art teacher. She feels that she is boring and failing, so Webster tries to help her.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E1 — Designer Genes
Tia and Tamera slip backstage at a red-hot fashion show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E2 — A Separate Peace
Fed up with sharing the same bedroom, the twins are torn between getting their own rooms.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E3 — Working Girls
Ray's budding relationship with a new woman leaves Tamera feeling jealous.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E4 — Show Me the Money
When Tamera learns that Tia is being paid less than a male co-worker, she poses as Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E5 — It's My Party
The twins sneak to Chicago to celebrate their 17th birthday.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E17 — Scary Marriage
Moesha and her friends are matched up in a mock marriage for a homework assignment.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E18 — Saving Private Rita
Moesha saves a suicidal friend, while Dorian pretends to be religious to impress a cute girl.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E19 — Mayhem At The Jam
A concert gets out of Moesha’s control and Hakeem takes a beating.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E20 — Creepin’
Moesha and Hakeem’s relationship heats up, while Dorian dates an older woman.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E21 — Graduation Day
Dorian’s new older girlfriend is enticing him with promises of a record deal, while Mo and Hakeem fight about trust.

S2 E10 — Temptations
When Mary (Marla Gibbs) accepts the 'glamorous' title of Chairwoman of the Church benefit variety show, she soon realizes it's really a dirty job and prays for a group like the 'Temptations' to save the show.

S2 E11 — Father's Day
A surprise visit by his Air Force dad prompts Calvin to bid farewell to the family in exchange for a new life abroad with his father.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

S2 E13 — Check Snub
When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E10 — Hoop Schemes
In order to impress Nicolette and humiliate a potential suitor, Eddie steps in for Malcolm to coach a youth basketball team.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E11 — Two Men And A Baby
Eddie enlists Malcolm to help babysit for his infant cousin.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E12 — The Way We Weren't
An argument leads to Malcolm and Eddie recalling their years together.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E13 — It Almost Happened One Night
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E14 — Whose Room Is It Anyway
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E10 — The Shoot Out
When Lamont brings home an antique gun, Fred pulls the trigger and is surprised to learn the gun was loaded. Fred has just had an argument with his neighbor Herman Goldstein and the bullet careens through Goldstein's window.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E11 — The Puerto Ricans Are Coming! The Puerto Ricans Are Coming!
Fred is upset because his new neighbor is opening a competing junkyard -- but he's beside himself when he learns the neighbor is Puerto Rican. Fred vows to remedy the situation, over the strong objections of Lamont, who has become Julio's friend.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E18 — The Other Woman
Tom Willis' latest business trip may be his last if Helen finds out who he is traveling with and what kind of 'business' they have in mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E19 — The Hold Out
George gets caught between his morals and his money when his efforts to increase his take on a business deal turn him into an unlikely neighborhood hero.
